# steps

1. open `http://localhost:4714/`
2. if the 2.5 banner shows at the top, dismiss it
3. expand API reference, then Users, and open Create a user
4. click into the code editor, select everything and replace it with `{"name": "Grace"}`, run it and show the error that comes back
5. fix the request by writing a valid body with the email grace@example.com and the plan team, run it and wait for the response
6. press the slash key to focus the search, type `rate` and pick Rate limits using the arrow keys and enter
7. go to SDK installation and use the keyboard arrow keys to move across the language tabs
8. press the Copy button
9. in the live demo frame press Increment counter three times
10. press Yes, helpful in the feedback widget at the bottom
11. click the Download SDK button
12. scroll to the changelog at the bottom
